            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3685400/202510/3685400-20251024145555262-1990370788.png" alt="【URP】Unity[视差遮挡贴图]原理剖析实践" class="desc_img">
        视差遮挡贴图(POM)是一种高级渲染技术，通过光线步进算法精确计算视线与高度图的交点，模拟复杂表面的几何遮挡效果。相比标准视差贴图，POM能更真实表现深度变化和自阴影，适用于高精度材质。其核心是分层深度检测和动态采样优化，根据视角动态调整采样层数，并通过二分法逼近精确UV。Unity URP实现中，关键点包括动态采样层数、光线步进循环和二分法优化。技术对比显示POM精度最高但性能消耗较大，适合PC/主机平台，移动端需减少采样层数。建议高度图使用法线贴图的Alpha通道节省资源，控制_ParallaxScal
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<blockquote>
<p><a href="https://blog.csdn.net/chenghai37/category_13021255.html?fromshare=blogcolumn&amp;sharetype=blogcolumn&amp;sharerId=13021255&amp;sharerefer=PC&amp;sharesource=chenghai37&amp;sharefrom=from_link" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">【从UnityURP开始探索游戏渲染】</a><strong>专栏-直达</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<h1 id="视差遮挡贴图parallax-occlusion-mapping-pom介绍"><strong>视差遮挡贴图（Parallax Occlusion Mapping, POM）介绍</strong></h1>
<p>视差遮挡贴图是视差贴图技术的高阶实现，通过‌<strong>光线步进（Raymarching）算法</strong>‌精确计算视线与高度图的交点，模拟复杂表面（如砖墙、岩石）的几何遮挡效果。相比标准视差贴图，POM能更真实地表现深度变化和自阴影，适用于高精度材质表现。</p>
<h1 id="核心原理"><strong>核心原理</strong></h1>
<ul>
<li>‌<strong>分层深度检测</strong>‌将视线方向在切线空间分解为多层（通常8-15层），逐层采样高度图，通过二分法逼*视线与表面的交点。</li>
<li>‌<strong>动态采样优化</strong>‌根据视角与法线的夹角动态调整采样层数（**行视角增加层数，垂直视角减少层数），*衡精度与性能。</li>
<li>‌<strong>遮挡关系重建</strong>‌通过交点处的UV偏移修正纹理采样位置，模拟凹凸表面的光线遮挡效果。</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h1 id="unity-urp-实现示例与原理详解"><strong>Unity URP 实现示例与原理详解</strong></h1>
<h2 id="代码关键点解析"><strong>代码关键点解析</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p>‌<strong>动态采样层数</strong>‌</p>
<ul>
<li>通过<code>lerp(_MaxSamples, _MinSamples, saturate(dot(float3(0,0,1), viewDirTS)))</code>实现视角自适应分层，优化性能。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p>‌<strong>光线步进循环</strong>‌</p>
<ul>
<li>循环比较当前层高度与采样深度，找到首个交点区间，避免全精度遍历。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p>‌<strong>二分法优化</strong>‌</p>
<ul>
<li>在初步交点区间内使用<code>lerp</code>插值计算精确UV，减少采样次数。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p>ParallaxOcclusionMapping.shader</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">Shader "Universal Render Pipeline/POM"
{
    Properties
    {
        _MainTex("Albedo", 2D) = "white" {}
        _NormalMap("Normal Map", 2D) = "bump" {}
        _HeightMap("Height Map", 2D) = "white" {}
        _ParallaxScale("Height Scale", Range(0, 0.1)) = 0.05
        _MinSamples("Min Samples", Int) = 8
        _MaxSamples("Max Samples", Int) = 15
    }

    SubShader
    {
        Tags { "RenderPipeline"="UniversalPipeline" }

        HLSLINCLUDE
        #include "Packages/com.unity.render-pipelines.universal/ShaderLibrary/Core.hlsl"

        TEXTURE2D(_MainTex);    SAMPLER(sampler_MainTex);
        TEXTURE2D(_NormalMap);  SAMPLER(sampler_NormalMap);
        TEXTURE2D(_HeightMap);  SAMPLER(sampler_HeightMap);
        float _ParallaxScale;
        int _MinSamples, _MaxSamples;

        float2 ParallaxOcclusionMapping(float3 viewDirTS, float2 uv)
        {
            // 动态计算采样层数
            int numSamples = (int)lerp(_MaxSamples, _MinSamples, saturate(dot(float3(0,0,1), viewDirTS)));
            float layerHeight = 1.0 / numSamples;
            float2 deltaUV = _ParallaxScale * viewDirTS.xy / viewDirTS.z / numSamples;

            // 光线步进初始化
            float currentLayerHeight = 0;
            float2 currentUV = uv;
            float currentDepth = 1 - SAMPLE_TEXTURE2D(_HeightMap, sampler_HeightMap, currentUV).r;

            // 分层检测
            [loop]
            for (int i = 0; i &lt; 15; ++i) {
                if (currentLayerHeight &gt;= currentDepth) break;
                currentUV -= deltaUV;
                currentDepth = 1 - SAMPLE_TEXTURE2D(_HeightMap, sampler_HeightMap, currentUV).r;
                currentLayerHeight += layerHeight;
            }

            // 二分法精确交点
            float2 prevUV = currentUV + deltaUV;
            float prevDepth = currentDepth - layerHeight;
            float weight = (currentLayerHeight - currentDepth) / (prevDepth - currentDepth);
            return lerp(currentUV, prevUV, weight);
        }
        ENDHLSL

        Pass
        {
            HLSLPROGRAM
            #pragma vertex vert
            #pragma fragment frag

            struct Attributes
            {
                float4 positionOS : POSITION;
                float2 uv : TEXCOORD0;
                float3 normalOS : NORMAL;
                float4 tangentOS : TANGENT;
            };

            struct Varyings
            {
                float4 positionCS : SV_POSITION;
                float2 uv : TEXCOORD0;
                float3 viewDirTS : TEXCOORD1;
            };

            Varyings vert(Attributes IN)
            {
                Varyings OUT;
                VertexPositionInputs posInput = GetVertexPositionInputs(IN.positionOS.xyz);
                OUT.positionCS = posInput.positionCS;

                // 转换视角方向到切线空间
                VertexNormalInputs normInput = GetVertexNormalInputs(IN.normalOS, IN.tangentOS);
                float3 viewDirWS = GetWorldSpaceViewDir(posInput.positionWS);
                OUT.viewDirTS = TransformWorldToTangent(viewDirWS, 
                    normInput.tangentWS, normInput.bitangentWS, normInput.normalWS);

                OUT.uv = IN.uv;
                return OUT;
            }

            half4 frag(Varyings IN) : SV_Target
            {
                // 计算POM偏移后的UV
                float2 pomUV = ParallaxOcclusionMapping(normalize(IN.viewDirTS), IN.uv);

                // 采样最终纹理
                half4 albedo = SAMPLE_TEXTURE2D(_MainTex, sampler_MainTex, pomUV);
                half3 normalTS = UnpackNormal(SAMPLE_TEXTURE2D(_NormalMap, sampler_NormalMap, pomUV));

                return half4(albedo.rgb, 1);
            }
            ENDHLSL
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h1 id="技术对比与性能建议"><strong>技术对比与性能建议</strong></h1>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>特性</th>
<th>标准视差贴图</th>
<th>陡峭视差贴图</th>
<th>POM</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>‌<strong>采样次数</strong>‌</td>
<td>单次</td>
<td>5-15次</td>
<td>8-15次+二分法</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>‌<strong>陡峭表面精度</strong>‌</td>
<td>低</td>
<td>中</td>
<td>高</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>‌<strong>适用*台</strong>‌</td>
<td>移动端</td>
<td>PC/主机</td>
<td>高端PC</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>‌<strong>推荐参数</strong>‌</td>
<td><code>Scale=0.02</code></td>
<td><code>Scale=0.05</code></td>
<td><code>Scale=0.03-0.07</code></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h2 id="实际应用中需注意">实际应用中需注意：</h2>
<ul>
<li>高度图建议使用法线贴图的Alpha通道节省资源</li>
<li>过高的<code>_ParallaxScale</code>可能导致边缘拉伸，建议不超过0.1</li>
<li>移动端可减少<code>_MaxSamples</code>至8层以降低开销</li>
</ul>
